'''Zhu Qingshi''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry|FRSC]] ({{lang-zh|s=朱清时}}; born 7 February 1946) is a Chinese physical chemist and writer. He is the former president of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] (1998–2008),<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |url=http://chinavitae.com/biography/Zhu_Qingshi/bio |title=China Vitae |access-date=2010-11-16 |archive-date=2011-05-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110503140307/http://www.chinavitae.com/biography/Zhu_Qingshi/bio |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://dcp.ustc.edu.cn/2013/1208/c4479a39695/page.htm|title=朱清时|website=dcp.ustc.edu.cn|access-date=2018-11-07}}</ref> and the founding president of [[Southern University of Science and Technology]] (2009–2014).

Zhu Qingshi was a descendant of the [[House of Zhu|imperial family of the Ming dynasty]] and the twentieth descendant of Zhu Chun, Prince of Shu, the eleventh son of [[Zhu Yuanzhang]]. Zhu Qingshi's family settled in Bailuchang Township, Peng County, after the fall of the Ming, and they are local prominent families.<ref>{{Cite web|title=中科大校长、朱元璋后裔朱清时欲在彭州建书院|url=http://www.chinanews.com/n/2003-01-30/26/268769.html|accessdate=2020-03-08|work=中新网|archive-date=2021-03-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210313103827/http://www.chinanews.com/n/2003-01-30/26/268769.html}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
1946. Zhu was born in [[Chengdu]], [[Sichuan]], China.<ref name=":1" />

1963. Graduated from Huaxi Secondary School in Chengdu (originally called Chengdu 13th School), China.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.wccdaily.com.cn/shtml/hxdsb/20130505/94888.shtml|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151223190528/http://www.wccdaily.com.cn/shtml/hxdsb/20130505/94888.shtml|url-status=dead|archive-date=2015-12-23|title=华西都市报—川人朱清时：锋芒背后的成都底色|date=2015-12-23|access-date=2018-11-07}}</ref>

1968. Graduated from the [[University of Science and Technology of China]] with a degree in physics.<ref name=":1" />

1991. Elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.dicp.cas.cn/gkjj/lyys/zqs/|title=朱清时院士----中国科学院大连化学物理研究所|website=www.dicp.cas.cn|access-date=2018-11-07|archive-date=2018-11-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181108065544/http://www.dicp.cas.cn/gkjj/lyys/zqs/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

1994. Became chief of its Laboratory of Bond Selective Chemistry.

1996. Appointed Vice-president of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]].<ref name=":1" />

1998. Appointed the President of the [[University of Science and Technology of China]].<ref name=":1" />

== Honours ==
*Academician [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]
*Honorary doctorate, Soka University of Japan
*1994 Thompson Memorial Award, ''Spectrochima Actas''<ref name=":1" />''.''
